purpose: Teach: どん底/城壁/順応/蒸発/牽制/発着/老齢/海戦

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、国家がどん底から立ち直った事例を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura — you wrote your paper on how nations recovered from rock bottom, correct?
lines.style: Warm, confirming tone. Slight lift at the end, inviting agreement. Steady and encouraging, the teacher who already knows the answer but asks to let the student speak.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、中世の城壁建築史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote mine on medieval castle-wall architecture.
lines.style: Clear, direct response. Slight pause before the actual topic—she's correcting the assumption gently but matter-of-factly. Respectful but not overly deferential.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 生物の環境順応研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You covered biological environmental adaptation in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, moderately paced. A light pause before the question, as if reviewing mental notes. Open and genuinely curious, not testing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、近代の蒸発事件を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on a modern-era disappearance case.
lines.style: Steady, factual delivery. No apology in the tone—she's simply stating what she wrote. Calm correction, eyes level.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 国家間の牽制関係を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you examined the power dynamics between nations in your paper?
lines.style: Engaged, slightly forward lean in the voice. Warm confirmation seeking. The teacher actively following along, investing in the conversation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、空港の発着史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about the history of airport arrivals and departures.
lines.style: Composed, unrushed. A faint hint of patience—she's answering a third different question. Not frustrated, just clear and precise.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 老齢化社会の論点を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You addressed the issues of an aging society in your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentler pace, reflective quality. The teacher thinking aloud as much as questioning. Warm, inviting Sakura to expand if she wishes.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、近代の主要海戦を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote on the major naval battles of the modern era.
lines.style: Final answer, settled and complete. Steady breath, no trailing off. Calm finality, as if this is the last piece she needs to say.
